scope: Exact comparison against private JWT/refresh/recovery/cookies/passwords>=12chars/envkeys/fullDBURLs plus short-password explicit credential assignments. Supplemental scoped scan, not universal absence-of-secrets proof. No values or token digests published.

priorScannerFailure.classification: Lexical false positive: a short local database password also occurs as SQL/database identifiers and prose, without a credential assignment or complete private DB URL. Initial lexical matches preserved; no secrets removed/replaced to hide an exposure.
